mapper.select: SELECT scenario_synonym_no, keyword_no, synonym, weight, use_yn, frst_reg_dt, lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario_synonym WHERE keyword_no = #{keywordId} ORDER BY weight DESC, synonym

SELECT k.scenario_no, sy.keyword_no, sy.synonym, sy.weight FROM tb_scenario_synonym sy JOIN tb_scenario_keyword k ON k.scenario_keyword_no = sy.keyword_no WHERE k.scenario_no = #{scenarioId} AND k.use_yn = 'Y' AND sy.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY k.scenario_no, sy.weight DESC, sy.synonym

SELECT k.scenario_no, sy.keyword_no, sy.synonym, sy.weight FROM tb_scenario_synonym sy JOIN tb_scenario_keyword k ON k.scenario_keyword_no = sy.keyword_no JOIN tb_scenario s ON s.scenario_no = k.scenario_no JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_no IS NOT NULL AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND k.use_yn = 'Y' AND sy.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY k.scenario_no, sy.weight DESC, sy.synonym
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario_synonym (keyword_no, synonym, weight, use_yn) VALUES (#{keywordNo}, #{synonym}, #{weight}, #{useYn})
